name: Circular Mirror with Four Bosses, Thread-Relief Decoration of Dragons, Birds, Tigers, and Other Animals, Quatrefoil, and Auspicious Inscription
summary: This circular mirror has a wide, flat outer rim embellished with a slightly sunken ring of chevron patterns in thread-relief down the center.  This rim gives way to a beveled edge that sinks down to a lower field of decoration consisting of a narrow band of radiating lines; a circular band of animals in thread-relief; another narrow band of radiating lines; a band of medium width that is plain and undecorated; another band of radiating lines; and finally a quatrefoil with characters interspersed
